title: [France] test_s2: shape, null rates, length distribution
corrections_to_work_order: Department token counts quoted in the work order (nord 152011, gironde 150787, calais 128762, atlantique 128348) are s1+s2+s3 sums, not s2 figures. s2-only: 75362 / 75104 / 55273 / 63697.
The 0.8874% n-deletion figure is pooled over three test files. s2's own rate is 1.0859%.
D119's 10.68% s2 cell is the six-word figure; the four-word visible share is 10.5464%.
denominator_note: All rates divide by by_country['France'].rows = 703378 unless stated.

name_length_histogram.note: bucket 0 contains zero empties since name_empty=0, so all 25983 are 1-9 chars

n_empty_deletion.mechanism: ADDR_CANON_FR 'n' -> '' (normalize.py:214), so the token is dropped at normalize.py:349-350
n_empty_deletion.empty_mapping_family_note: n is not the only token deleted. ADDR_CANON_COMMON (normalize.py:197-198) also maps number/no/nos/num/h/hno/house/door/plot/flat/shop/null/na/none/nil to '' and all survive into the effective France canon (normalize.py:322 drops only st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w from COMMON; n is re-supplied by ADDR_CANON_FR:214).
n_empty_deletion.verdict: intentional behaviour; n/no unselective and keys.py:42 requires len>=3 so neither can be a blocking key. Denominator correction, not a code recommendation.

function_words_fr_test_s2.d119_arithmetic_note: D119's 10.68% s2 cell is the SIX-word figure; the four-word visible share is 10.5464%. Brief instruction to use 10.68% is correct and is followed.
function_words_fr_test_s2.corrected_basis: normalize.py:334-335 matches a whole comma-component against FR_REGIONS and continues, so de/la inside hauts de france, pas de calais, pays de la loire, ile de france never reach atoks. build_profile.py:126-127 has no equivalent guard.

department_style_tokens_test_s2.note: token OCCURRENCES, not rows; build_profile.py flattens components so a count is not automatically pipeline-visible

WORK_ORDER_CORRECTION.finding: Those four are sums over s1+s2+s3, NOT s2 figures. Verified to the row: nord 75362+76449+200=152011; gironde 75104+75621+62=150787; calais 55273+57522+15967=128762; atlantique 63697+64398+253=128348.
WORK_ORDER_CORRECTION.consequence: calais in s2 is 2.33x smaller than quoted (55273 not 128762); 15967 of the quoted mass is s1-only, the region-style source.

side_observation_d077.note: D077's number is exactly the pooled France comma rate; independently confirms D128's criterion-mismatch conclusion.

adequacy.reason: s1 has 0% addr_empty, 100% comma, mean addr 50.07 vs 39.55; s3 matches s2 closely on every shape metric

measurement_corrections_not_code_defects: n-deletion per-file split: s2 = 1.085912% of its own listed mass, not the pooled 0.887390%
empty-mapping family in s2 = 1.897265% (n 51535 + no 35995 + h 1990 + na 520), a lower bound; 66.7645% of the family's mass sits in s2
department token counts in s2 are roughly half the pooled figures quoted in the work order
gaps: No cross-field overlap counts (addr_empty AND has_comma, addr_empty AND digit-name are not recorded)
addr_tokens/name_tokens are top 4000 per country; absence is not proof of non-occurrence
name-length histogram is bucketed at 10 chars only; exact per-length distribution not available
entity_id prefix check is startswith('S2-') only; full entity_id format validity not verifiable from the profile
